body: I just tested performance on an Adreno 640 device and can confirm that my suggested change improves performance significantly over the current state of the PR. But it is still a slight decrease in performance compared to master. I don't think we can avoid it, so let's go ahead with this PR with my suggested changes here.
There was a leftover "p.xyz / p.w;", but I added the rest of the change.
